description: Source code implementing internal logic for a media player, including media time calculation, player instance management, seeking, setting bounds, retrieving info, and configuration handling.

classes.name: SbPlayerPrivate
classes.description: Class managing internal state and operations of a media player instance, including playback controls, info retrieval, and configuration.

methods.name: CalculateMediaTime
methods.description: Calculates current media time based on last known media time, update timestamp, and playback rate.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new SbPlayerPrivate object.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks the media player to a specified time and updates internal state.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream for a given media type.

methods.name: SetBounds
methods.description: Sets rendering bounds for the video output.

methods.name: GetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves current player info such as timestamp, size, volume, and frame counts.

methods.name: UpdateMediaInfo
methods.description: Updates internal media timing and frame drop info based on new data.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decode target for rendering.

methods.name: GetAudioConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves available audio configurations, prioritizing HDMI connector if present.
